criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Play Media
categories.definition: Play a specific song, album, artist, playlist, genre, era, or other media content.

categories.name: Add Media to Playlist
categories.definition: Add a song, album, artist, or other media item to a specified playlist.

categories.name: Rate Media
categories.definition: Assign a rating or score to a specific or currently referenced media item.

categories.name: Find Media Information
categories.definition: Search for details, trailers, or availability of a specific movie, TV show, book, game, image, or music.

categories.name: Get Movie Showtimes
categories.definition: Inquire about movie schedules, showtimes, or what films are playing at specific locations.

categories.name: Get Weather Forecast
categories.definition: Request current or future weather conditions, temperature, or specific weather events for a given location and time.

categories.name: Book Restaurant Reservation
categories.definition: Make or inquire about a reservation at a restaurant, specifying details like time, date, party size, location, or cuisine.
